lines.1: 「Scary stories are the one thing Crab Fried Rice can't handle.」
lines.2: 「Your spiritual sensitivity is just way too low!」
lines.3: 「I can kind of sense that stuff, you know.」
lines.4: 「So, there you have it. Our school is haunted.」
lines.5: 「But what if the voice Fukahire heard belonged to Ms. Ringo Hirose, the thirty-three-year-old single teacher who moved here from Aomori?」
lines.6: 「Ugh. It might have sounded like her.」
lines.7: 「Mystery solved. That's usually all there is to these things.」
lines.8: 「Ryuumeikan has plenty of other ghost stories, though. They say you can hear a woman moaning on the roof at midnight, crying, 'Yes! Yes!'」
lines.10: 「Wouldn't that just be some couple who snuck into school to fool around?」
lines.11: 「And stop plastering yourself against me. I know you're scared, but let go.」
lines.12: 「D-do you not understand words? I said I'm not scared!」
lines.13: Now she wrapped herself up in my bedding.
lines.14: 「You know, I'm pretty sure some ghosts appear under the covers.」
lines.16: 「And they always target the people who are most frightened.」
lines.19: Tormenting her in moderation was always best.
